main.description: Send an email via Graph POST /users/{fromUpn}/sendMail. Requires Azure app-only Mail.Send. This host capability is unconditional — policy routing (internal direct / external draft_only) is enforced by the caller (e.g. com.etzhayyim.apps.microsoft.sendMail). For Teams channel posting, pass the channel email address as a recipient (channel_email_via_mail_send pattern).

token.description: App-only Bearer access token from m365.acquireAppToken

fromUpn.description: Sender mailbox UPN (required). Caller resolves this from role / caller identity / configured default.

bodyHtml.description: HTML body. Takes precedence over bodyText if both provided.

bodyText.description: Plain text body (fallback when bodyHtml absent).
